messages.subject: Renewal
messages.text:
Shlomi,

We're happy with the product. The team uses it every day. That said, the board froze new spend until March, so any expansion waits until then. Renewal at the current seat count is fine.

Jared will handle the paperwork and send the signed order form by 23 October.

Gavin Belson
CEO, Hooli
